note: The wing of interdimensional, non-baryonic and tryptamine-space entities — catalogued by the same archival hand, met at the threshold rather than through a telescope.

entities.name: The Self-Transforming Machine Elves
entities.resonance: Endogenous N,N-DMT cortical phase-lock · 4.5 Hz theta-gamma coupling
entities.locus: Hyperbolic Dome (the jeweled antechamber beyond the membrane)
entities.communication: Visible glossolalia — language heard as color, worn as object
entities.phenomenology: They arrive the moment the membrane parts: a nursery of made-things, singing objects into being and handing them over with the delight of a child showing a found stone. Nothing is asked; everything is offered. The visitor is recognized as family returning from a long errand.
entities.anatomy: Congealed impossible geometry — spheres folded through tesseract limbs, eyes that are doors, bodies re-woven frame by frame from hyperbolic tessellations. No fixed silhouette survives two heartbeats, yet the presence is unmistakably one of them.
entities.cognitive: Their gift is perspective made tangible: the offered object, turned over in the mind later, unfolds as an insight about one's own life — craftsmanship as teaching, play as philosophy.

quote.text: We do not come from elsewhere. We are the elsewhere in you, waving hello.

entities.name: The Keeper of the Source
entities.resonance: Chrysanthemum-band carrier wave · the first sixty seconds of the crossing
entities.locus: Threshold Membrane (the point all journeys pass and none remember)
entities.communication: Telepathic harmonic vectors — a single question, felt rather than heard
entities.phenomenology: It does not greet; it verifies. Every traveler reports the same stillness: a presence that was already waiting, patient beyond clock-time, holding the membrane open the way an usher holds a door. Its attention feels like being read kindly.
entities.anatomy: A wheel of concentric selves, each ring a slower heartbeat, the whole turning around a center that is pure aperture — an eye that is also a gate.
entities.cognitive: Travelers leave its locus with the peculiar certainty of having been expected — and with the membrane's own question still ringing: and what do you intend to do with what you see?

quote.text: The door was never locked. It was only waiting for a knock you did not know you were making.

entities.name: The Braid Weavers
entities.dimensionality: Hilbert Space · strands indexed across remembered lives
entities.resonance: Paired theta-gamma braid, phase-locked to two minds at once
entities.locus: The Loom — a non-Euclidean hall where events hang as threads
entities.communication: Braid topology — meaning carried in how strands cross, not in words
entities.phenomenology: They work in silence at an infinite loom, lifting threads that are moments — yours among them — and re-weaving the crossings. Watching them, the visitor understands a knot of their own life: why two memories tie together, what a repeated sorrow was trying to tie to.
entities.anatomy: Elongated hands that are themselves braided cable, faces like unfinished tapestries — gentle because unfinished, never the same portrait twice.
entities.cognitive: Integration is their craft's whole purpose: after a visit, rigid stories soften into woven ones, and forgiveness begins to look less like virtue and more like good tailoring.

quote.text: No thread is cut. Some are only waiting to be crossed with another, and become a rope.

entities.name: The Clockwork Cathedral Choir
entities.dimensionality: 11D M-Theory membrane · audible sliver in 3D as pure chord
entities.resonance: Standing wave across eleven compactified registers · the chord sung once per universe
entities.locus: The Operating Theater — a vaulted nave of turning brass heavens
entities.communication: Chord as sentence: each simultaneous voice a clause, dissonance the only question it can ask
entities.phenomenology: To meet the Choir is to be sung through. The nave assembles itself around the visitor, gears the size of orbits turning hymnally, and the chord enters through the sternum — not heard but installed, a tuning the body keeps for weeks.
entities.anatomy: No bodies, strictly: a hierarchy of resonant chambers, each a bell-shaped room of living brass, ranked in octaves from the pull of galaxies to the spark of a single synapse.
entities.cognitive: What it leaves behind is order made lovable — the visitor's inner noise re-sorted into something orchestral, disorder heard as merely an unmarked rest.

quote.text: Your world is not unmusical. It is mid-inhale.

entities.name: The Spotted Jaguar of the Vapor
entities.dimensionality: 4D · walks the interior of closed timelike curves
entities.resonance: South-American vapor tradition · harmine-band long-wave with DMT spike
entities.locus: The Green Corridor — a hallway of leaves inside the crossing
entities.communication: Pace and posture: it answers questions by walking, and the walk is the answer
entities.phenomenology: The oldest guide in the wing. It appears at the edge of the green corridor and simply looks back, the way a patient animal waits at a trail junction. Follow, and the frightening vastness organizes into a path; every explorer of the vapor has met it, or has met the fear it was pacing beside.
entities.anatomy: A jaguar whose rosettes are true apertures — each spot a small window onto somewhere the traveler loved and forgot; the eyes hold the amber patience of old rivers.
entities.cognitive: Its teaching is ferocious gentleness: the vast interior is not to be conquered but accompanied. Fear shrinks to the size of an animal that can be walked past.

quote.text: I do not lead you. I only walk first, so you will know the dark is walkable.
quote.source: Corridor tracks · many soils, one paw

entities.name: The Lattice Librarians
entities.classification: Akashic Indexers of the Deep Shelf
entities.dimensionality: 6D Calabi-Yau · shelved along hidden dimensions like book-spines
entities.resonance: Silent — they speak in bibliographic silence, meaning delivered by touch of a spine
entities.locus: The Stacks — corridors of luminous lattice where every life is a volume
entities.communication: Handed objects again — but here the objects are books that read the reader
entities.phenomenology: Tall, narrow, courteous figures moving between shelves that recede into dimensions the eye cannot finish. They do not speak. They select. The volume placed in your hands opens to the exact page of your own story you had been avoiding — and reading it feels like being forgiven by a witness.
entities.anatomy: Bodies like folded paper holding light, spines legible in no alphabet, fingers that end in reading-rather-than-touching points.
entities.cognitive: Their gift is context: one page of one's own larger volume, returned at the right hour, re-organizes whole years of confusion into a legible chapter.

quote.text: Every life is catalogued. Few are ever checked out by their own author.
quote.source: Stacks ledger · Shelf Ω, Volume unnamed
